source_evidence: Public companies must file this report for each of the first three quarters of their fiscal year.  (After the fourth quarter, public companies file an annual report instead of a quarterly report.)
question: Misconception: Public companies file a Form 10-Q for each of their four fiscal quarters.
answer: Correction: Public companies file Form 10-Q for the first three fiscal quarters. After the fourth quarter, they file an annual report instead.
